verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a cloud identity service, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows Entra ID offering such an opt-out. The diagnostic settings item covers routing activity logs to endpoints for retention, which is an adjacent logging feature and not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
